text:
Nina L: Quick heads-up: after last week's batch of reviewer exceptions we need to run a short audit before the calibrations export tomorrow. I noticed 12 exceptions without a reason field filled. Can we triage?

Raj P: Oof. Do we have the export path? I'll pull the exceptions CSV and grep for empty reason.

Amanda R: Export is at /internal/people-ops/exceptions/2026-q1/batch-exports/exceptions-2026-02-20.csv. The policy requires a manager note for every exception. If it's missing we should either attach a note or revoke the exception.

People Ops Bot: Reminder: policy "review-deadline-exception" requires manager signoff and reason. Missing data will block calibration exports if enforce_data_integrity=true.

Raj P: Pulled the CSV. 12 rows where reason=="" and manager_approval=="approve". They appear to be mixed APAC and EMEA. I'll DM the managers for quick confirmation.

Evan T: Suggestion: create a lightweight remediation flow: 1) send a templated manager ping asking to confirm reason within 6 hours, 2) mark exception as pending_revoke after deadline, 3) flag affected reviews in calibration CSV with note "pending_reason" so evaluators know to skip until resolved.

Amanda R: Agree. Keep the process minimal. We can't afford to delay calibrations >12h. If managers don't respond within 6h we'll auto-revoke and notify reviewers+managers.

Nina L: I'll draft the manager template. Want language that is short: what we granted, why we need a reason, and the 6h deadline. Also include a reply format like: "approve: personal leave" or "revoke".

Raj P: DM'ed the 12 managers. So far 5 replies with reasons. Marking those rows as complete.

People Ops Bot: Audit ticket created: AUD-5092 12 exceptions missing reason. Progress: 5/12 resolved.

Evan T: I'll update the calibration export job to include a column audit_status (ok/pending/revoked) and to append audit_notes for any pending rows. That way the calibration lead can decide whether to include or exclude. ETA 1h.

Amanda R: Good. Also: for transparency add an audit trail link in the export header: /internal/people-ops/audit/AUD-5092. Calibration lead should be notified to expect a small update.

Nina L: Manager template: 

"Hi <Manager>, we granted a reviewer deadline exception for <employee>. Our records show the reason field is blank. Please reply within 6 hours with the reason (e.g., \"personal leave\", \"timezone constraint\") or reply 'revoke' to cancel the exception. If we don't hear back we'll automatically revoke and notify affected reviewers. Thanks, People Ops."

Raj P: More managers replied. Now 9/12 resolved. Two asked for a short extension to collect info (asking for 12h). We should deny ad-hoc extensions as policy says 6h for reason.

Amanda R: Deny extensions; maintain fairness. If they provide a reason we can re-evaluate on a case-by-case basis but don't delay the export. Please proceed with auto-revoke where necessary.

People Ops Bot: AUD-5092 update: resolution threshold reached for roll forward. Auto-revoke executed for 3 exceptions at 1825001300. Affected reviewers notified.

Evan T: Calibration export modified; audit_status included. I've pushed the export to /internal/people-ops/calibration_exports/2026-02-21-with-audit.csv and notified the calibration lead.

Nina L: Thanks all. Post-action: I'll open a short retrospective to propose a mandatory reason field on the exception form (can't submit without it) to prevent this class of issue. Will add to backlog and sync with Eng for a small validation change.

Amanda R: Perfect. Also add a note in the review-cycle runbook: "exceptions without reason will be auto-revoked after 6h".

People Ops Bot: AUD-5092 closed at 1825001420. All actions logged to /internal/people-ops/audit/AUD-5092/log.json.
